title: factdiff.py anchors --stale lists 31 anchors of facts that no longer exist in claude, logs and python articles, which anchor --file leaves because no cited source selects them
goal: factdiff.py anchors --stale prints stale=0: the anchors of reworded or removed facts in claude/api-limits.csv, claude/hooks.md, claude/messages-api.md, logs/microsoft-sentinel.md, logs/otel-collector-receivers.md, logs/otel-log-semconv.md and python/uv-projects.md are pruned, and a refresh that rewords a fact leaves none behind.
